name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), audio domain, descriptor bgm_enabled_flag correctly reflects it is a boolean flag and its purpose (BGM enable). No Ghidra address residue. Verified semantics match name via all 9 xref sites.
purpose: User-toggleable "music on" option flag: gates whether BGM plays (volume 0x7F vs muted 0).
logic_summary: 1-byte boolean. Reader fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade @ 0x25A3A and the Game Options menu set BGM sequence volume to 0 when this flag is 0, else 0x7F (the sequence still loads/inits/starts regardless; only volume is gated). Toggled in Game Options menu slot 0 via XOR-1 in fd2_game_options_menu_loop, which also issues AIL_set_sequence_volume(handle, new?0x7F:0, 1000) for a 1-sec fade. Persisted in FD2.SAV preferences: written to save slot byte +0xA08 by fd2_save_current_state_to_slot, restored from slot +0xA08 by fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot and fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher, and from header byte +0x30D3 by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine. Lives adjacent to data_fd2_audio_sfx_enabled_flag (+1 byte, 0x51E62).
element_semantics: 0 = BGM disabled (mute, volume 0); nonzero (ships as 1) = BGM enabled (volume 0x7F). Single scalar, not an array.
notes: src/life/main.c lines 989-994: comment already accurate and concise (uint8 boolean; ships enabled image value 1; restored from FD2.SAV +0xA08/+0x30D3; gates BGM track changes) -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit. Ghidra program saved. Image byte value verified = 0x01 at 0x51E61. Inline-script classloader emitted stale prior-build error logs but the data-plate read/write both completed successfully.
